name: Upright piano
definition: acoustic piano with a vertical frame and strings, hammers striking the strings from the front.

name: Grand piano
definition: Acoustic piano with a horizontal frame and strings in a wing-shaped case; grands come in several sizes.

name: Digital piano
definition: electronic keyboard instrument made to reproduce the piano, with a weighted or piano-style action and built-in sound.

name: Harpsichord
definition: keyboard instrument whose strings are plucked by quills or plectra.

name: Pipe organ
definition: keyboard instrument sounding through ranks of pipes fed by wind, including church and chamber organs also played outside worship.

name: Tonewheel organ
definition: electromechanical organ that generates its tones with rotating tonewheels.

name: Synthesizer
definition: Electronic instrument that makes sound with its own engine and is played or sequenced as one whole unit; keyboard, desktop and rack versions, and different synthesis methods.

name: Modular synthesizer module
definition: A single synthesizer function built to be mounted with others in one rack or mount system, such as Eurorack.

name: Drum machine
definition: electronic instrument that produces drum and percussion sounds and plays them from a built-in sequencer.

name: Sampler
definition: electronic instrument that records, stores and plays back sound samples from its pads or keys.

name: Theremin
definition: electronic instrument played without contact, pitch and volume set by the hands' distance from two antennas.

name: Groovebox
definition: All-in-one instrument combining synth, drum and sample voices with a built-in pattern sequencer.

name: Solid-body electric guitar
definition: electric guitar with a solid body and magnetic pickups.

name: Semi-hollow electric guitar
definition: electric guitar with a hollow body around a solid centre block.

name: Hollow-body electric guitar
definition: electric guitar with a fully hollow, archtop-style body.

name: Steel-string acoustic guitar
definition: acoustic guitar with a hollow body strung with steel strings.

name: Classical guitar
definition: acoustic guitar with a wide neck strung with nylon or gut strings.

name: Resonator guitar
definition: acoustic guitar whose sound is projected by one or more metal resonator cones.

name: Bass guitar
definition: electric or acoustic fretted bass instrument tuned an octave below the guitar's lowest strings.

name: Ukulele
definition: small four-string plucked lute of the guitar family.

name: Banjo
definition: plucked lute with a drum-like membrane soundtable on a round frame.

name: Mandolin
definition: small plucked lute with paired strings, usually tuned in fifths.

name: Oud
definition: Short-necked, fretless, pear-bodied plucked lute.

name: Sitar
definition: Long-necked plucked lute from India with movable frets and sympathetic strings.

name: Shamisen
definition: Long-necked, three-string plucked lute from Japan with a skin-covered body.

name: Koto
definition: Long board zither from Japan with movable bridges under each string.

name: Guzheng
definition: Long board zither from China with movable bridges.

name: Harp
definition: plucked string instrument whose strings run from a soundboard to a neck at an angle, in an open or framed body.

name: Violin
definition: Four-string bowed instrument held under the chin, the treble of the violin family; sold in fractional sizes.

name: Viola
definition: four-string bowed instrument held under the chin, larger and lower than the violin.

name: Cello
definition: four-string bowed instrument played seated with an endpin, the tenor-bass of the violin family.

name: Double bass
definition: largest and lowest bowed string instrument, played standing or on a high stool.

name: Flute
definition: concert flute in C: transverse flute sounded by blowing across an embouchure hole.

name: B-flat clarinet
definition: single-reed clarinet pitched in B-flat.

name: Bass clarinet
definition: single-reed clarinet pitched an octave below the B-flat clarinet, with its own body and mouthpiece.

name: Soprano saxophone
definition: single-reed saxophone of the soprano voice.

name: Alto saxophone
definition: single-reed saxophone of the alto voice.

name: Tenor saxophone
definition: single-reed saxophone of the tenor voice.

name: Baritone saxophone
definition: single-reed saxophone of the baritone voice.

name: Oboe
definition: double-reed woodwind with a conical bore.

name: Bagpipes
definition: Reed pipes (chanter and drones) sounded from a bag of air; regional types exist.

name: Trumpet
definition: valved brass instrument in the treble range with a mostly cylindrical bore.

name: Trombone
definition: brass instrument whose pitch is changed mainly with a slide.

name: French horn
definition: valved brass instrument with a coiled conical tube and a wide flared bell.

name: Tuba
definition: largest and lowest valved brass instrument.

name: Harmonica
definition: mouth-blown free-reed instrument with reeds in a row of channels.

name: Accordion
definition: Bellows-driven free-reed instrument with keyboard or buttons and bass buttons; the bayan and garmon are regional types.

name: Concertina
definition: small bellows-driven free-reed instrument with buttons on both ends.

name: Harmonium
definition: Free-reed instrument with a keyboard and hand- or foot-pumped bellows, also played in worship.

name: Melodica
definition: mouth-blown free-reed instrument played from a small keyboard.

name: Shruti box
definition: bellows-driven free-reed drone instrument without a keyboard.

name: Acoustic drum kit
definition: set of acoustic drums (and usually cymbals and hardware) played by one drummer.

name: Electronic drum kit
definition: drum kit of pads or mesh heads that trigger electronic sounds from a sound module.

name: Snare drum
definition: shallow double-headed drum with snare wires across the lower head.

name: Crash cymbal
definition: cymbal made for loud accents.

name: Ride cymbal
definition: large cymbal made for a sustained ride pattern.

name: Hi-hat cymbal
definition: pair of cymbals mounted on a stand and closed by a pedal (sold as a pair).

name: Splash cymbal
definition: small, thin cymbal with a short, quick decay.

name: China cymbal
definition: cymbal with an upturned edge and a trashy, cutting tone.

name: Cajon
definition: Box-shaped wooden drum played by hand while sitting on it.

name: Djembe
definition: Goblet-shaped hand drum with a skin head.

name: Timpani
definition: tuned kettle drum with a bowl-shaped shell, played with mallets.

name: Marimba
definition: tuned mallet percussion instrument with wooden bars and resonators.

name: Singing bowl
definition: Standing bowl bell sounded by striking or rubbing the rim; one made for a rite is in Religious & Ceremonial Objects.

name: Music box
definition: mechanism that plays a tune by a pinned cylinder or disc plucking a tuned steel comb.

name: Barrel organ
definition: organ played mechanically by turning a pinned barrel.

name: Musical saw
definition: saw blade bent and bowed or struck to sound a sustained tone.

name: Glass harmonica
definition: set of graded glass bowls on a spindle, sounded by rubbing the rims with wet fingers.

name: Combo amp
definition: Instrument amplifier and loudspeaker in one cabinet; sold as tube, solid-state, modelling or hybrid, in various wattages and speaker sizes.

name: Amp head
definition: instrument amplifier without a loudspeaker, made to drive a separate cabinet.

name: Speaker cabinet
definition: loudspeaker enclosure made to be driven by an amp head.

name: Amp modeller
definition: floor or desktop unit that carries amplifier models (usually with effects) in place of an amplifier.

name: Distortion effect
definition: Unit that clips the instrument signal hard for a distorted sound.

name: Overdrive effect
definition: unit that clips the signal softly to emulate a driven amplifier.

name: Delay effect
definition: unit that repeats the signal after a set time.

name: Multi-effects processor
definition: unit offering several effect types in one housing and no amplifier models.

name: Large-diaphragm condenser microphone
definition: Condenser microphone with a large capsule, sold for recording music; USB and XLR versions exist.

name: Dynamic microphone
definition: Moving-coil microphone sold for music on stage or in the studio.

name: Wireless microphone system
definition: microphone or bodypack transmitter with its receiver, sold for music performance.

name: Audio interface
definition: External unit that converts microphone and instrument signals for recording music on a computer.

name: Audio mixer
definition: Console that combines, levels and routes several audio channels; analogue or digital, with varying channel counts.

name: Studio monitor
definition: near-field loudspeaker cabinet made for monitoring in recording and mixing.

name: PA speaker
definition: Pole-mount or flown loudspeaker cabinet made for live sound; powered or passive.

name: Studio headphones
definition: Headphones sold by their maker as studio, stage or DJ equipment.

name: In-ear monitor system
definition: Stage in-ear monitoring kit with a transmitter and a bodypack receiver.

name: DI box
definition: direct-input box that converts an instrument signal to a balanced microphone-level signal.

name: DJ controller
definition: control surface with jog wheels, faders and pads for DJ software.

name: DJ turntable
definition: direct-drive record turntable sold for DJ performance.

name: MIDI keyboard controller
definition: keyboard that makes no sound of its own and sends MIDI or other control data to sound sources.

name: Pad controller
definition: grid or bank of pads that sends control data to software or hardware, for beat-making, recording or DJing alike.

name: Guitar strings
definition: set or single string made for a guitar or bass.

name: Guitar case
definition: hard or soft case made to hold one guitar or bass.

name: Drumstick
definition: stick made for playing drums and cymbals, sold as a pair.

name: Music stand
definition: stand that holds sheet music or a tablet at reading height for the player.

name: Metronome
definition: device that sounds or shows a steady, settable beat.

name: Tuner
definition: device that shows how far a played note is from the target pitch.

name: Practice mute
definition: mute that quiets an instrument for practice, made for several instruments.

name: Reverb effect
definition: Unit that adds simulated room, hall, plate or spring reverberation to the signal.

name: Boost effect
definition: Unit that raises the signal level with little or no added clipping.

name: Subwoofer
definition: Loudspeaker cabinet for low frequencies only, sold to extend studio monitors or a PA system.

name: Bassoon
definition: double-reed woodwind with a folded conical bore, the bass of the woodwind section.

name: Tanpura
definition: Long-necked unfretted plucked lute from India that sounds a drone on open strings.

name: Hammered dulcimer
definition: Trapezoid box zither whose strings are struck with light hammers; the santoor and yangqin are regional types.

name: Bouzouki
definition: Long-necked plucked lute with paired metal strings, Greek or Irish.

name: Electronic organ
definition: organ that generates its tones electronically (analogue or digital), including home, combo and church organs without pipes.

name: Electric piano
definition: electromechanical piano whose hammers strike tines, reeds or strings read by pickups (Rhodes, Wurlitzer type).

name: Rotary speaker cabinet
definition: amplified speaker cabinet with rotating horn and drum, made for organs and keyboards.

name: Veena
definition: Long-necked fretted plucked lute from India with one or two gourd resonators.

name: Taus
definition: Bowed long-necked fretted lute from India with sympathetic strings (taus, esraj, dilruba).

name: Piccolo
definition: small transverse flute sounding an octave above the concert flute.

name: Alto flute
definition: transverse flute pitched in G, a fourth below the concert flute.

name: Bass flute
definition: transverse flute pitched an octave below the concert flute, with a folded head.

name: Alto clarinet
definition: single-reed clarinet pitched in E-flat between the B-flat and bass clarinets.

name: C clarinet
definition: single-reed soprano clarinet pitched in C.

name: Xylophone
definition: tuned mallet percussion with hard wooden or synthetic bars, brighter and higher than the marimba.

name: Vibraphone
definition: tuned mallet percussion with metal bars, resonators and motor-driven vibrato fans, with a damper pedal.

name: Tongue drum
definition: steel or wooden drum with cut tuned tongues struck by hand or mallet.

name: Electronic percussion pad
definition: self-contained pad unit with built-in or sampled sounds, played with sticks or hands.

name: Jaw harp
definition: lamella in a frame held to the mouth and plucked, the mouth shaping the overtones.

name: In-ear monitors
definition: stage or studio earphones (universal or custom-moulded) sold as monitoring gear, without transmitter.

name: Wind controller
definition: breath-driven controller with keys that sends MIDI or control data, often with its own sounds.

name: MIDI foot controller
definition: floor unit of footswitches or pedals that sends MIDI or control data to other gear.

name: Fuzz effect
definition: Unit that squares the signal into a saturated, buzzing fuzz tone.

name: Chorus effect
definition: Unit that mixes the signal with slightly delayed, pitch-modulated copies.

name: Flanger effect
definition: Unit that mixes the signal with a very short, swept delay for a jet-like sweep.

name: Phaser effect
definition: Unit that sweeps notches through the signal with all-pass filter stages.

name: Tremolo effect
definition: Unit that modulates the signal volume (or pitch, as vibrato) at a set rate.

name: Compressor effect
definition: Unit that narrows the dynamic range of the instrument signal.

name: Wah effect
definition: foot-rocked or envelope-driven unit that sweeps a resonant filter across the signal.

name: Looper
definition: unit that records and plays back loops of the live signal for overdubbing.

name: Pitch-shifter effect
definition: Unit that adds or replaces the signal with a shifted pitch (octave, harmony, whammy).

name: EQ effect
definition: Unit that boosts or cuts set frequency bands of the instrument signal.

name: Noise gate
definition: unit that mutes the signal below a set threshold to cut hum and hiss.

name: Volume pedal
definition: foot-rocked pedal that sets the level of the instrument signal.

name: Euphonium
definition: valved tenor brass instrument with a wide conical bore, pitched in B-flat.

name: Recorder
definition: Duct flute blown at the end through a fipple, with a thumb hole; sold in several voice sizes.

name: Bar chimes
definition: row of hanging metal bars or tubes swept or struck for a shimmering effect.

name: Small-diaphragm condenser microphone
definition: condenser microphone with a small capsule, sold for recording instruments.

name: Ribbon microphone
definition: velocity microphone with a thin metal ribbon element, sold for music recording.

name: Flugelhorn
definition: valved brass instrument in B-flat with a wide conical bore and mellow tone.

name: Kokyu
definition: Small bowed spike lute from Japan with a skin body.

name: Hichiriki
definition: Short cylindrical double-reed pipe from Japan, used in court music (gagaku).

name: Microphone preamp and channel strip
definition: unit that raises a microphone signal to line level, alone or with EQ and dynamics in one channel strip.

name: Portable audio recorder
definition: handheld or field recorder with built-in or plug-in microphones that records to a memory card.

name: DAW control surface
definition: control surface of faders, knobs and buttons that controls recording software or plug-ins.

name: 500-series module
definition: preamp, EQ or dynamics module built to mount in an API 500-series rack (lunchbox).
